audience: teams that pull data out of emails, PDFs and other documents with Parsio

useCases.title: Review the parsed data of a mailbox
useCases.text: List the mailboxes and open the parsed data of recent documents. Check that the extracted fields are right.

useCases.title: Check the table fields and templates of a mailbox
useCases.text: Read the table fields and the templates of a mailbox to see what the parser extracts.

useCases.title: Test a template on sample text
useCases.text: Send a text or HTML sample to a mailbox and read the extracted result. Use it to test a template before real mail arrives.

useCases.title: Parse a document again after a template change
useCases.text: Find the document that failed. Then parse it again so the new template applies.

useCases.title: Check which webhooks and senders a mailbox uses
useCases.text: List the webhooks of a mailbox and the emails it collected.
